rationale.ai-review: Adversarial agents independently challenge, synthesize, and judge candidate assessments.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Complete debates and score breakdowns support informed human interpretation.
rationale.risk-routing: Bias, disagreement, and data-quality signals automatically prioritize enhanced human review.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Mandatory review gates, override authority, pause controls, and intervention are specified.
rationale.oversight-theater: Paper critiques nominal review that merely rubber-stamps opaque AI recommendations.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: Architecture explicitly operationalizes EU AI Act Articles 14, 26, and 27.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Tamper-evident records persist agent reasoning, inputs, and human decisions.
rationale.counterpoint: Opposes procedural compliance layers and shallow explainability dashboards.
rationale.framework: Presents a reusable reference architecture with mapped components and controls.
rationale.design-only: Specifies buildable architecture but reports no implementation or evaluation.
rationale.general-ai: Overseen object is employment decision AI, not AI-generated code.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Architecture substantively mitigates automation bias and reviewer rubber-stamping.
rationale.risk-bias: Adversarial checks and escalations explicitly target discriminatory candidate assessments.
